_comment: 由 tools/zh/zh.py text-extract 生成；zh 为空表示未翻译（回退原文）。控制码沿用 <LINE>/<DONE>/<PLAYER> 等写法，{{n}} 为不可翻译的占位命令，必须原样保留。

Text_ThisIsABigBattle.en: What? This is a<LINE>big battle!<CONT>Leave me alone!<DONE>
Text_ThisIsABigBattle.zh: 咦？这是一场<LINE>大对战！<CONT>别来烦我！<DONE>

YoungsterJoey1SeenText.en: I just lost, so<LINE>I'm trying to find<CONT>more #mon.<PARA>Wait! You look<LINE>weak! Come on,<CONT>let's battle!<DONE>
YoungsterJoey1SeenText.zh: 我刚输了，<LINE>正想去找<CONT>更多宝可梦。<PARA>等等！你看起来<LINE>很弱！来吧，<CONT>对战一场！<DONE>

YoungsterJoey1AfterText.en: Do I have to have<LINE>more #mon in<PARA>order to battle<LINE>better?<PARA>No! I'm sticking<LINE>with this one no<CONT>matter what!<DONE>
YoungsterJoey1AfterText.zh: 难道要变得<LINE>更强，<PARA>就得拥有<LINE>更多宝可梦吗？<PARA>不！我就是要<LINE>带着这一只，<CONT>无论如何！<DONE>

YoungsterMikeySeenText.en: You're a #mon<LINE>trainer, right?<PARA>Then you have to<LINE>battle!<DONE>
YoungsterMikeySeenText.zh: 你是宝可梦<LINE>训练家吧？<PARA>那我们一起<LINE>对战吧！<DONE>

Bug_catcherDonSeenText.en: Instead of a bug<LINE>#mon, I found<CONT>a trainer!<DONE>
Bug_catcherDonSeenText.zh: 没逮到虫子，<LINE>反倒找到<CONT>一个训练家！<DONE>

Route30YoungsterText.en: These train tracks<LINE>lead all the way<CONT>to Goldenrod City!<PARA>I'm having fun<LINE>balancing on them.<DONE>
Route30YoungsterText.zh: 这条铁轨<LINE>一直通到<CONT>满金市呢！<PARA>我在上面<LINE>走平衡，<CONT>可好玩了。<DONE>

Route30CooltrainerFText.en: I'm not a trainer.<PARA>But if you look<LINE>one in the eyes,<CONT>prepare to battle.<DONE>
Route30CooltrainerFText.zh: 我不是训练家。<PARA>不过，和训练家<LINE>目光相接的话，<CONT>就该准备对战。<DONE>

MrPokemonsHouseDirectionsSignText.zh: 宝可梦<LINE>老爷爷的家，<CONT>往前走就到！<DONE>

Route30TrainerTipsText.en: Trainer Tips<PARA>No stealing other<LINE>people's #mon!<PARA># Balls are to<LINE>be thrown only at<CONT>wild #mon!<DONE>
Route30TrainerTipsText.zh: 训练家提示<PARA>不许偷别人的<LINE>宝可梦！<PARA>精灵球只能<LINE>扔向野生的<CONT>宝可梦！<DONE>

Route30AdvancedTipsText.en: Advanced Tips!<PARA>During a battle,<LINE>press Select to<CONT>switch #mon!<PARA>Press Start to<LINE>reuse an item!<PARA>Or press B to<LINE>run away or<CONT>forfeit!<PARA>When you're choos-<LINE>ing a move to use,<PARA>press Select to<LINE>swap it with an-<CONT>other one, or<PARA>press Start to see<LINE>its description!<DONE>
Route30AdvancedTipsText.zh: 进阶提示！<PARA>对战中按<LINE>选择键，<CONT>就能换宝可梦！<PARA>按开始键<LINE>可再次使用<CONT>道具！<PARA>或者按B键<LINE>逃跑、<CONT>认输！<PARA>在选择招式时，<LINE>按下选择键<PARA>就能和其他<LINE>招式对调，<CONT>或者按开始键<PARA>看招式说明！<DONE>

YoungsterJoeyText_GiveHPUpAfterBattle.en: I lost again…<LINE>Gee, you're tough!<PARA>Oh yeah, I almost<LINE>forgot that I had<CONT>to give you this.<PARA>Use it to get even<LINE>tougher, OK?<PARA>I'm going to get<LINE>tougher too.<DONE>
YoungsterJoeyText_GiveHPUpAfterBattle.zh: 我又输了……<LINE>哇，你真厉害！<PARA>啊，差点忘了<LINE>有东西<CONT>要交给你。<PARA>用它变得<LINE>更强吧！<PARA>我也会<LINE>变强的。<DONE>
